deferral.reason: The exact profile registry and empirical capability facts are not frozen.

evaluation_contract.formula: For each exact profile and semantic requirement, resolve feature and operation variables, evaluate the closed predicate, preserve unknown as unresolved, and emit one exact profile × feature × obligation × operation applicability result for each eligible operation.
evaluation_contract.operation_rule: Eligible operations are the exact intersection of the profile operation identities and the requirement operation scope; operation counts are never inferred by a multiplier.
